title: The Superheterodyne Radio: No really, that's its name
summary: Technology Connections explains why the superheterodyne radio has its name and how mixing frequencies lets it tune stations well. It walks through the underlying wave phenomena and algebra and why the design solved a hard tuning problem.
why: HN people use it as the accessible go-to explainer for the superhet trick whenever radios or signal processing come up.

quote.text: This video is a great explainer (and I also highly recommend every other video on the channel)
